texts.report_kernel_line: the density-weighted continuation step with the P-wave barrier on the isospin-complete towers (baryonic, strange baryonic, strange mesonic) with the Delta-like lines; the isovector exchange fraction free; diffractive shapes free.

kernel_change.delta_lines: the I = 3/2 root families at Q = +1 and 0 (the isovector exchange's Delta-like lines)
